game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Coastal Port – Salt Pans, salt evaporation pans: the harbor master must handle sea serpents while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Not Negator: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the harbor master slips through safely.
theme: Coastal Port – Salt Pans: salt evaporation pans
core_gameplay_loop: In Salt Pans, repeat each round: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the harbor master slips through safely. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the stealth value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the dock crane using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The dock crane reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the dock crane is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 3 (intro tier): Not Negator
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Not Negator' (Week 3 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Salt Pans'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stealth changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sea serpents in Salt Pans.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The dock crane reached with actions_used <= 15.
